title: SPOILER! HOW TO DO KULDRA FIGHT RuneScape: Dragonwilds
author: Kurt Pearl
description:
Sloppy beginning but I just got on after a couple days so I was a bit rusty, please forgive me, my Lords. Straight to the point step by step instruction. 

Goal is to Charge the Cannon and use it to damage Kuldra. Use Anima dispenser to get Anima Orb and put into cannon. Each phase is slightly different as you'll see in the video. I recommend taking care of mobs first to make it as easy as possible unless they're clearly far away enough not to be aggro'd. Be mindful of giant purple beam.

Good Luck! If you have any questions, comment please!
